description.value:
Slot none; Price 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)
Weight 5 lbs.; Feat Cost 1 sp

An extended talent lasts twice as long as normal. A talent with a duration of concentration, instantaneous, or permanent is not affected by this effect, but you may choose to activate this metamagic effect when spending a spell point to make a talent you are concentrating on last without concentration, rather than when you initially cast the sphere effect.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Extend Spell; Cost 2,500 gp (lesser), 5,000 gp (normal), 10,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Use as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect while holding this apparatus in at least one hand. The effect must be caster level seven or lower. Spend one of 3 daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat’s extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Double a qualifying duration; concentration, instantaneous and permanent durations do not benefit. Alternatively apply when spending a spell point to make the effect persist without concentration, rather than at initial casting.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
